title: Calibration between interviewers, and the bias that survives good intentions

videos.script: Before Renata arrived, Agenda's debriefs always opened with Diego. He was the most senior engineer, and he had strong opinions quickly. {{title}} Paula stopped saying what she thought. By the time it was her turn, the decision felt made. {{paula}} Nobody had changed their mind on new evidence. They had moved towards the first number they heard. {{anchor}} This lesson is about protecting four interviews from that. Writing the score down before hearing anybody else. {{write}} The biases that good intentions do not reach, and the structure that does. {{bias}} How to run the debrief, starting from the disagreement. And what one chart showed about Diego's scores, that he had never seen. {{chart}}
